question: What alternative oblation may an excellent practitioner perform at this stage?
premises: A substance called nābhi-kāñjalka is specified
An excellent practitioner should offer it
inference: Alternatively, an excellent practitioner may perform an oblation with the substance called nābhi-kāñjalka.
uncertainties: nābhi kāñjalkaṃ is an obscure ritual substance or compound
plain_english: Or else, an excellent practitioner should offer the nābhi-kāñjalka in oblation.
